thesis: Public signals for JPMorgan Chase are mostly routine: filings are timely and insider activity is unremarkable. No item requires a committee response.
invalidation_rationale: Signals are qualitative; a change in the flagged items would change the read.
conviction_reason: Signals point in different directions with no clear trend.
self_evidence_reason: Filing indexes were sampled; news-tone and hiring data were not available.
missing_data: Hiring and employee-sentiment data (no source in the inputs)

red_flags.flag: Regulatory capital proposals could raise required capital for the largest banks.

sources.title: Current reports (8-K) — JPM (SEC EDGAR filing index)
Quarterly reports (10-Q) — JPM (SEC EDGAR filing index)

signals.signal: Recent current reports focus on routine business updates; credit normalisation and lower net interest income as policy rates fall is the recurring theme.
Quarterly filings arrived on the usual schedule with no late-filing notices.
Insider filings show routine award and plan-based transactions, no unusual clusters.
